run_daterange_generator: run the daterange generator to iterate over dates between a start and end date
summarize_daterange: summarize the daterange function that yields dates using datetime.timedelta for a given date range
run_yaml_to_csv_conversion: run the script to convert YAML line count files to CSV for a date range
review_daterange: review the daterange generator function that yields each date between start and end
refactor_daterange: refactor the daterange function to include the end date in the generated range
